title: Three Currencies, Three Invoices
description: The same shipment priced three different ways for three different customers' books — prove the fixed exchange-rate math lands exactly where the constants say it should, in every currency SwiftCargo supports.
successCondition: Book three identical-package shipments (same weight/dimensions/route, so the same USD priceCents) and create one invoice per shipment with currency EUR, GBP, and INR respectively. For each, compute the expected amountCents yourself using the fixed rates in apps/api/src/modules/billing/currency.ts applied to the shipment's priceCents, and confirm it matches the invoice.amountCents returned by the API exactly (integer cents, no rounding drift). Querying invoices via `npm run db:psql` for the three new rows confirms currency and amount_cents match your hand-computed values exactly, and each row's shipment_id is unique (one invoice per shipment, never shared).
hints: Use identical origin/destination/package on all three bookings so the underlying USD priceCents is the same baseline for your manual conversion math.
apps/api/src/modules/billing/currency.ts's rates are fixed constants, not live FX — round the same way the service does (check the file) to avoid an off-by-one-cent false failure.
